sections.title: Scotland: Castles, Culture & Highlands
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
Scotland: Castles, Culture & Highlands

Experience Scotland’s rich heritage and breathtaking landscapes on a journey through historic cities, charming villages, and the legendary Highlands. Explore iconic castles, vibrant culture, and local traditions from Edinburgh to Loch Ness, with immersive visits, tastings, and guided walks along the way.

sections.title: Day 1 - Welcome to Edinburgh
sections.html:
Welcome to Edinburgh

Arrive in Scotland’s historic capital and settle in. Gather for a welcome orientation and drink, with a memorable appearance by a traditional Scottish bagpiper. Enjoy the evening at leisure.

sections.title: Day 2 - Edinburgh: Stories and History
sections.html:
Panoramic city tour and guided orientation walk

Discover Edinburgh on a panoramic city tour and guided orientation walk.

National Museum of Scotland

Explore Scotland’s heritage at the National Museum of Scotland.

Real Mary King’s Close

Descend beneath the Royal Mile for an atmospheric visit to the Real Mary King’s Close.

Independent exploration

Time remains for independent exploration.

sections.title: Day 3 - Royal Edinburgh
sections.html:
Palace of Holyroodhouse visit

Visit the Palace of Holyroodhouse, the royal residence at the foot of the Royal Mile.

Edinburgh Castle visit

Visit Edinburgh Castle, dramatically perched above the city.

Evening at leisure

Enjoy an evening at leisure.

sections.title: Day 4 - Museum Collections, Leith and the Kelpies
sections.html:
Behind-the-scenes museum archive experience

Enjoy a behind-the-scenes museum archive experience featuring a talk, questions and a collection visit.

Visit to Leith waterfront district

Continue to the waterfront district of Leith for lunch and free time.

Guided visit to the Kelpies sculptures

Discover the monumental Kelpies sculptures on a guided visit.

sections.title: Day 5 - St Andrews and Scottish Distilling
sections.html:
Explore St Andrews cathedral grounds and castle

Travel to St Andrews to explore the historic cathedral grounds and castle.

Scottish distillery group lunch, guided tour and tasting

Continue to a Scottish distillery for a group lunch, guided tour and tasting.

Travel onward to Aberdeen

Travel onward to Aberdeen.

sections.title: Day 6 - Highland Cattle and Balmoral
sections.html:
Explore the village of Ballater

Explore the charming village of Ballater.

Visit a Highland cattle farm

Visit a Highland cattle farm to meet its distinctive shaggy-haired residents and learn about local farming traditions.

Tasting lunch

Enjoy a tasting lunch before visiting Balmoral Castle’s grounds, gardens and exhibitions.

Visit Balmoral Castle

Visit Balmoral Castle’s grounds, gardens and exhibitions, subject to seasonal access.

sections.title: Day 7 - Inverness and Loch Ness
sections.html:
Guided walk through Inverness

Journey into the Highlands for a guided walk through Inverness.

Scenic drive along Loch Ness

Take in the scenery along legendary Loch Ness, with opportunities for photographs.

Discover Clava Cairns

Discover the ancient Clava Cairns before returning to Aberdeen.

Visit Culloden battlefield

Visit the historic Culloden battlefield before returning to Aberdeen.

sections.title: Day 8 - Return to Edinburgh and Farewell Dinner
sections.html:
Travel back to Edinburgh

Travel back to Edinburgh and enjoy free time to explore, shop or revisit favorite places.

Farewell dinner

Celebrate the journey together over a special three-course farewell dinner.

sections.title: Day 9 - End of the Journey
sections.html:
Breakfast

Enjoy breakfast and conclude the cultural tour.

Optional mosaic workshops

Travelers continuing with separately arranged mosaic workshops may begin their next creative experience.
